### The Handwriting on the Wall - Homeword - September 18
Author: Robin Dugall
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/the-handwriting-on-the-wall-homeword-september.html
Passage: Daniel 5:5-6
Points:
- Belshazzar perverted the blessing of community into a prideful feast that openly mocked God with sacred vessels.
- God shattered the monarch's arrogance with the sudden and terrifying appearance of handwriting on the plaster wall.
- Believers must recognize divine conviction when they misuse their own lives, minds, or resources in dishonoring ways.
- Spiritual growth requires giving the Holy Spirit room to convict us of compromises and turning away from them.
